_format: One entry per board. ats must be greenhouse, lever, ashby, or avular (the only adapters src/job_sources/ has -- avular is a one-off single-site parser, see PROJECT_NOTES.md). domain is optional -- used for company-identity matching in dedup; omit it if you don't have one handy. Add or remove a company by adding or removing one object below -- no code change needed. For avular, board_token is the site's base URL, not a per-tenant token (see api/job_discovery_scheduler.py's ATS_LISTING_URL comment).
